name: Bathroom Lighting Upgrade Timeline: What to Expect

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Thinking about a bathroom lighting upgrade? It's a fantastic way to refresh your space, and understanding the general timeline can help you plan. While every project is unique, here’s a typical phase-by-phase breakdown of what you can expect when you’re looking to enhance your bathroom’s illumination.

step.name: Step 2
step.text: **Phase 1: Initial Assessment & Design.** This is where we figure out what you need. We'll look at your bathroom's layout, existing wiring, vanity size, mirror placement, and ceiling height. We'll discuss your goals—do you want more task lighting, better ambient light, or just a fresh new look? This phase also involves exploring different fixture types like vanity bars, sconces, recessed lights, and mirror lights, and how they can best avoid shadows for grooming. You'll choose fixtures that complement your style and provide the right amount of light.

step.name: Step 3
step.text: **Phase 2: Planning & Material Acquisition.** Once the design is locked in, we'll finalize the exact fixtures, dimmers, and switches needed. We'll also consider if any new circuits are required or if switch relocation is desired. This is the stage where we order all the materials. If the lighting upgrade is part of a larger bathroom remodel, this phase often overlaps with other material selections.

step.name: Step 4
step.text: **Phase 3: Installation & Wiring.** This is when the magic happens! For hardwired fixture changes, new circuits, or dimmer installations, a professional will handle the electrical work. Access to wiring is generally easier during a larger remodel, especially before walls are closed up, which can make the process more efficient and cost-effective. We’ll ensure all installations near tubs or showers meet safety standards for damp or wet locations.

step.name: Step 5
step.text: **Phase 4: Finishing Touches & Testing.** Once everything is installed, we'll make sure all connections are secure, test dimmers and switches, and ensure your new lighting system is working perfectly. You'll get to enjoy your beautifully lit bathroom! If you’re ready to illuminate your bathroom, HH Remodeling LLC is here to help coordinate all the necessary steps.
